home.headline: Spend a semester somewhere new.
home.description: Find a partner at another university. Explore exchange profiles by field of study, location, and availability.

profile.title: Create a profile
profile.description: Enter your university and field of study. Your university tells us your city, country, and region.

preferences.title: Add exchange preferences
preferences.description: You can add your availability and the countries or regions you’d like to visit.

matches.title: Find an exchange partner
matches.description: Browse exchange profiles worldwide or filter by region. When you’re both interested, you can get in touch.

login.title: Sign in or register
login.description: Enter your email address to start an exchange profile.
login.demo: Email verification is pending. Use this browser session to edit your profile. Sign-in links will come later.

error.unavailable: The session could not be started. Try again.

errors.forbidden: This request was blocked. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalid_request: Check your entries and try again.
errors.invalid_profile: Enter a name and check your profile details.
errors.invalid_reference: Choose a university from the suggestions and select a field of study.
errors.invalid_period: Enter both months in order, or leave both empty.
errors.invalid_teaching_areas: Enter a title and select an experience level for each new teaching area.
errors.invalid_preferences: Choose up to 30 valid destinations without duplicates.
errors.profile_required: Save your exchange profile to see suggestions.
errors.match_unavailable: This suggestion is no longer available.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: These details help us suggest exchange partners. You can change them at any time.
profile.name: Name
profile.search: Search by university name or abbreviation
profile.optionalDates: Dates are optional. Leave both months blank to match across all time intervals.
profile.optionalDestinations: These appear on your profile. Use the region filter on Exchange suggestions to narrow your search.

matches.explanation: Results are sorted by availability overlap.
matches.show: Show suggestions | Show one suggestion | Show {count} suggestions
matches.anyDates: Showing suggestions across all time intervals.
matches.emailLater: Email contact will open when both addresses are verified.
matches.empty: No suggestions fit these filters. Try another region, period, or minimum overlap.
